Laura / Connor,

I've drafted a concise one-pager (attached as Finova_Impact_Summary_v2.pdf) that frames the outcomes in customer-facing language. Suggested topline metrics to include in the one-pager:
- 42% median 95thp latency reduction for production inference (post-optimization)
- 3.4x sustained throughput for peak batch windows (Q3 comparison)
- 27% reduction in cost-per-inference after compact model + prefix caching
- 99.92% uptime (last 90 days)

I kept the appendix separate (usage_metrics_2026_q3.csv) so we can share it with procurement on request. Proposed quote to ask Jake for: "Redwood helped us halve tail latency and reduce per-inference cost while handling 3x the load during busy windows — that directly improved our time-to-value for new features."

Connor: can you confirm the cost reduction number (27%) is safe to publish externally? Also, do you have a short recommended CSM/customer contact who could give a 1-2 line testimonial on adoption velocity?

I'll prep a final PDF and a short suggested email they can paste into their renewal packet.
